_comment: Copy to /etc/unifi-allowlist/config.json and chmod 600. Holds a UniFi password; never commit it.
_staticAllow: Addresses always kept in the group regardless of the Worker: your own static IP, a VPS, a monitoring host. CIDR is fine.
_minEntries: Refuse to write a member list shorter than this. Guards against a bad upstream response emptying the group and locking everyone out. Set to 0 only if an empty list is actually what you want.
_discordWebhook: Optional. A Discord channel webhook URL: one message per sync that adds or removes addresses, and one when syncing keeps failing. Treat the URL as a secret.
_alerts: Which alerts to send. mention is prepended to failure alerts, e.g. <@123456789012345678> for a user or <@&role id> for a role.

unifi._site: Site 'name' from the controller URL, not its display name. Usually 'default'.
unifi._credentials: Use a dedicated local-only admin with no MFA. Not your Ubiquiti SSO account.
unifi._unifiOs: true for UDM/UDR/UDM-Pro/Cloud Key gen2+ (paths under /proxy/network). false for a self-hosted controller.
unifi._insecureTls: Controllers ship self-signed certs, so this defaults to true. Prefer pinning tlsFingerprint256 instead of leaving this unchecked.
unifi._groupIds: Run the agent with --list-groups to find these. groupIdV6 is only needed if you enabled ALLOW_IPV6 on the Worker.
